t: In front of you is a bronze statue of Admiral of the Fleet Louis Mountbatten, Earl Mountbatten of Burma, standing on Mountbatten Green off Horse Guards Road. It was unveiled on the second of November, 1983. The sculptor was Franta Belsky, a Czech-British artist, and it was cast by the Meridian Bronze Foundry. Mountbatten served in the Royal Navy in both world wars, became Supreme Allied Commander in South East Asia, and later oversaw India's transition to independence as the last Viceroy. He was also an uncle of Prince Philip.
